cards.text: I say "be normal about it" and people become normal.
I pulled a tarot card about your "hey".
A small skull is a perfectly good gift.
Perfect date: a cemetery walk, then pasta.
A bookshop that smells like rain is a personality.
I choose the place. You pay attention.
Wednesday and Nosferatu. Both. Then I rank them.
Dramatic playlists are a love language.
I wore velvet to Nosferatu. Twice.
I reply to everything with a bat emoji.
